entry.title: New: RES23-230 (Honolulu) — FILE
entry.content:
URGING THE DIRECTOR OF TRANSPORTATION SERVICES TO UPDATE AND EXPAND THE CITY'S POLICY REGARDING THE USE OF RED CURBMARKINGS TO INCLUDE DESIGNATION OF ADDITIONAL AREAS WHERE PARKING IS PROHIBITED.

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.5 which sets a one-year filing period on pending resolutions.
